Sunday, Dec 28


ME
This is Riley.


Monday, Dec 29


SARAH 
This weekend we will be home, But the weekend after we will be in LA. Let me know if you wanted to play other board games or Dungeons & Dragons on a Thursday, night or Saturday and Sunday This weekend, Panera and Starbucks have plenty of parking and would be good, but panera closes at 8 PM.Thursday. Is a tea bar on oak avenue and broad, Have you been there?And do you know if they have tables , that would facilitate a d and d game?

ME
I'm busy this Thursday and Saturday, but I probably should be free Sunday (doing 2:30 again is a good time for me). I have not been to the tea bar, but Panera is fine with me, or Starbucks if you prefer there. 


Tuesday, Dec 30


SARAH 
I like panera because there are meals Available as well as cookies and treats. Star.\nBucks has a few little breakfast things , but I don't know if they would have run out by late afternoon.

ME
I'm fine with either, so whatever you prefer works for me.

However, I will say that one possible factor to consider is that there are a bunch of Starbuckses around, increasing the chances of miscommunication about where to meet, whereas there's only one Panera nearby, making it easier to find.

But if you, or anyone else who may join at some point, like Starbucks more, I'm sure it will work well enough. 

SARAH 
That's a good point. Choosing paneera offers more food options and less confusion.  Thanks.  

ME
No problem. So is the plan to meet at Panera this Sunday, 2:30, to play games?

SARAH 
Sure

I had announced this on next door and Facebook and you were the only person who came.So do you want to announce it to your friends that you know , and i'm happy to do dungeons and dragons if they'd rather.

ME
Awesome. 

I'll talk to my friends about it and get back to you.

SARAH 
Holy smokes comma it's not that I don't believe you but I don't believe anyone and I google to see how many Panera breads there were either in the tri-city area or the area. This is the only Panera in the entire county!  As a new arrival , I am still learning a lot about the geography. We only moved up here a couple months ago and it is quite different.

ME
Huh, I didn't know Panera was THAT scarce (I just entered Panera into Google maps and saw that the second-closest Panera was not that close)...Interesting.

SARAH 
The one we met at is the only one in the county, South of here , in yellow county , there's one inn springfield. I've been going to Springfield for various things.Because they have the only department store in the area. Even up by the university in hastinss , there's no macy's or nordstrom or bloomingdale's. 

ME
I don't know much about about stores or geography, but that's pretty fascinating. 

SARAH 
These are things i've taken for granted by living in a larger city. We had library hours that were 9 a m to 9 p m two cities over from me. It had study cubicles and a small coffee house within it for when people wanted to have conversations.   The population of this entire county is less than half of the population of the city where I lived , and I wasn't even in manhattan , proper. There are eighty seven other cities in the county. So because of the tiny population north of  delaware, there's not enough people for kaiser permanente , to operate up here. Even with new jersey, that's not enough potential customers , so they stop at brooklyn.

This\nIs how many Macy's department stores?I had to choose from near where I lived and worked, And that ain't even counting delaware. This is probably why i'm having difficulty finding other people who like board games or dungeons and dragons, I'm used to living in a area with A lot more people , so with only one in a thousand of us like something , that's still a sizable amount of people.

ME
Interesting, makes sense. 


Saturday, Jan 3


SARAH 
We were excited to hear somebody who knows how to be a dungeon master, Are we doing d and d tomorrow or is it board games?

ME
Well, I have not been able to get any friends to join (not yet, anyway), but if you guys want to play D&D and are okay with a party of 2, I can DM.

However, I'll need time to prepare, and we should probably discuss what we want the campaign to be like, so we could have a "session 0" tomorrow, then play board games the rest of the time, then properly start the campaign at a later date. 

SARAH 
Ok.  And I will hope that in the next day , in a couple of your friends say they will join. 

ME
To double-check: We're doing Panera, 2:30 tomorrow, right?

SARAH 
Yes.  We can do 3 or 3:30 if u prefer. 

ME
I'm good with pretty much whatever -- 2:30 works for me if it works for you. 


Sunday, Jan 4


SARAH 
Because it's raining out.I wanted to double check and see if you were still going to panera.  We can head over  To be there at two thirty. We don't mind rain. 

ME
Yeah, I'm still good to be there at 2:30.


Monday, Jan 5


ME
By the way, here's my email: mysticelfZZZ@gmail.com

SARAH 
This Sunday there's a group D n Ding at Springfield Library.   We may not be back up north by then. I was hoping to catch at least their last two hours. Do you want the info?

ME
No thank you, I'd rather not have to meet a bunch of new people if I don't have to. If you like that group and want to join them permanently, though, then I'll consider joining, and we could do that instead of me DMing a game. 

SARAH 
I'll let u know if they are nice if I make it up from LA in time.  They meet monthly on a Sunday,  so I may not see them till February. B

They were awesome.   When I arrived they had 2 tables, 2 DMs.  Both paused their games to welcome us.  The players didn't gripe about it.  They sometimes have a 3rd table.  Big conference room, so no library patrons would complain about noise.  We didn't have characters with us because I wanted to check the vibe.  I feel good about recommending it to u.  We're going next month, they meet monthly.  If u want to DM here I'd do both.  Springfield is only 16 minutes south.

We have plans this Sunday.  But we'll totally do a D n D w u if u have time.

SARAH 
Super. 


Tuesday, Jan 20

Okay, so I managed to get one friend interested in our D&D game, but he isn't available on Sundays. He's available Thursday nights though, and I think I could make those work (NOT this Thursday, though). Do you guys think Thursday, perhaps 6:00-8:00, at Panera would work for you?

This sunday is that springfield library dungeons and dragons group. We're going down for that if you would like to meet us there or i'm happy to pick you up. Springfield is about eighteen minutes away.

Again, it was such a big group.They always have two tables , sometimes three. That gives you a variety of choices on levels.   They had a full table of people that were under level seven suitable for my husband and I. I Didn't ask how high the levels went on the other table.

1pm. It does not give a stop time.

I googled and the library closes at five , so the gaming can't go past five. Probably wrap up at least 15 minutes early.So people can grab their gear.

Diary

Session 1 – Prelude: A Few Grains of Sand (1 Feb 2026)
Dragon attack! Troost and Galondomir fought a baby gencast dragon in an old ruin. They didn’t want to, but a voice was commanding the dragon, and the pair used their magic to defeat it.
The illusions of the ruin dissolved, revealing a metal room. A med team went to the dragon while Director Rodrick of the Dragon Warrior Academy applauded them (and the experimental dragon) on their test – they were now ready for missions for the Dragon Warriors.
As they were leaving, they bumped into a janitor clutching a mop and wearing a metal backpack, Avlae Pinooloo, who fangirled over the party and wanted to shadow them, though she expressed doubt that finding the True Dragons would be possible. Rodrick then asked the party to repair a flamerail turret that had become detached from the space station (called the Hourglass).
Unfortunately, all their dragons were sick, so they would have to do the job without them. The party got into space suits and cleverly used their magic to repair the turret. They also found possible signs of sabotage.
The party went to bed. Troost was awoken by something. Then a dragon landed on her window…and it broke the glass, and she was sucked into space! But her magic and Gal managed to bring her back inside, and they went to see what was happening.
Turned out: A full-on assault, with squadrons of dragons firing at the station and troops boarding. Rodrick tried to gain control of the situation while the party fought some invaders. Rodrick found the command room was out of commission, so the backup emergency button, in the bottom half of the Hourglass, would have to be reached in order to get reinforcements from the nearby planet LAX.
With Pinooloo tagging along, the party made a plan. They donned space suits and went outside the station, sneaking along its side with Gal's magic providing some propulsion, in order to sneak past the enemy. They managed to get to the lift separating the two halves of the Hourglass, but found it guarded. Troost used an invisible force to pull the dragon riders’ space suit tubes, distracting them and allowing the party to sneak inside to find the inside of the lift. They found it guarded, but much less than the outside, and took out the soldiers (Troost slitting the throats of the unconscious ones).
As they entered the lift, Pinooloo was suddenly shot! They dragged her into the lift and started the descent. Gal healed Pinooloo, but it didn't seem effective.
But as Troost and Gal prepared to exit the lift, they suddenly found Pinooloo tearing a hole in the wall with her mop-turned-halberd! She said sorry, but this was her operation and she wanted the party dead. She was a fan, but really, they were just like a couple grains of sand – what could they really accomplish? Her backpack unfolded into dark armor and she finished her hole, and she was sucked into space as a dragon filled the hole (Troost managing to get in a parting insult at Pinooloo).
Gal magic-shoved the dragon away, and, as the lift finished its journey, they pulled themselves out. They managed to find the backup emergency button room…but found the door being held shut.
It was Blu, a classmate they liked. She seemed scared, but the party suspected she might be a traitor. They managed to convince her to let them in, and they pressed the emergency button.
They waited…and waited…finally a dreadnought appeared, and the enemy was sent into retreat!
Rodrick congratulated the party, and told them that the next high-priority mission was definitely theirs. (Also, the party really wanted to talk to the Dragon Warriors Council about adding extra emergency buttons and background checks for janitors…)

Session 2 – Deep Secrets Part I: Gossip (8 Feb 2026)
Five days after the attack, Troost and Galondomir went into the Dragon Warrior Council meeting, where the council was bickering about what to do about the attack. Though it was kind of hard to get the council to listen, the party did manage to suggest getting the Scalax Realm’s senate to communicate with the Scalax Realm’s allies about the Bloodfire Empire.
Also, the liquid found in the magic vial in space turned out to just be water. Troost hypothesized that it might have been used to freeze the turret's latches to make it easier to break them. The dragons being sick during the attack was also found to be the result of poison. Additionally, prisoners from the attack revealed that the Empire intended to take the station and kill several people, including, most likely, Troost and Gal.
The party, eager to get information, asked Rodrick to go investigate. He said that there might be a mission soon – a Warrior on the surface of LAX Prime may have found something – but they could probably take a few days off. So they got some dragons and went to Lith, a mostly neutral, self-contained system, on the edge of Bloodfire Empire territory. They sniffed around the system's teleportation circle space station and found someone who lost an uncle in a recent Bloodfire attack. Apparently, Bloodfire agents entered a neutral trading post space station, the Trim Barrel, in disguise, tried to buy a perhaps dragon-related piece of paper, and then chaos suddenly erupted and the station was blown up, leaving few survivors (though a significant number of the stations’ defensive dragons were “missing,” not “confirmed dead”). While there, the party also found out that the Dragon Warriors, being government agents, weren’t trusted by some elements of society, and the Dragon Warriors were considered particularly weird and nosy.
The party then went down to the surface of Lith Prime and entered one of the more civilized cities, hiding their identities as dragon warriors. While Gal stayed behind to guard the dragons and talk with local police – who have been on the lookout for potential Bloodfire agents – Troost went into town in hunt of rumors and information. She found a little carnival with a lot of people and found a shady-looking, whispering group. She overheard them talking about the city’s defenses. She then, intending to get a better look at them, went up to them, pretending to be asking about where to get a drink, and one of them put a pistol to her stomach.

Session 3 – Deep Secrets Part II: Seedy Alleyways (15 Feb 2026)
Troost managed to talk her way out of being immediately shot, but she was soon lured into an alley by the shady-looking group and ambushed. She called for backup and managed to hold off the attackers until Gal got there, dragons blazing. The party killed two and took the last, a cat person, hostage. Gal used charming magic to get the cat person talking, and they found that the Bloodfire Empire was infiltrating and investigating the defenses of cities around the planet in preparation for invasion. The party then handed the cat over to the local police and headed back to the Hourglass for their next mission.
An agent on LAX Prime, Boris, had found a tourist that had found a secret second layer to a ruin on the planet. They were to meet Boris in a bar beneath the city of Draco Minor so he could lead them to the ruin and investigate it for dragon lore. However, when they got there (after getting Troost some better armor), they found him missing. His cloak was at a booth, and he was last seen at a designated smoking area. There, Gal used magic to talk to the sea life outside the underwater tunnel and found that Boris had been kidnapped by three people with fire-shaped ice tattoos. So they went off in search of Boris…

Session 4 – Deep Secrets Part III: Coldtists (22 Feb 2026)
Troost and Galondamir were stopped by someone whose cart apparently broke, but then they found themselves ambushed by two bounty hunters who were looking for them, as well as a third Dragon Warrior. Just then, Adrian, the third Dragon Warrior, arrived just as things were getting ugly, and though the two bounty hunters called in reinforcements – which ended up being a shooter in a building – the bounty hunters were defeated with the help of Adrian’s martial arts skills, with only the shooter surviving and getting away. Adrian, who’d been chasing down a lead for dragon lore that hadn’t panned out, decided to join Troost and Gal on their quest.
Gal talked to a squid and some dolphins for directions for where Boris had gone, then invited the animals to come with. The party found a building with scratches likely from a metal foot, and in the alley next to it they found a homeless-looking guy with an ice-fire tattoo pretend-sleeping in front of a door. Troost tried and failed to kill him via insults, then Gal intimidated him into getting his boss. Gal then turned into a mouse and followed him inside, finding Boris tied up in a room with a bunch of carousing gang members, called “the Coldtists.” He began nibbling on Boris’s ropes.
Meanwhile, the party’s squid friend was warning Troost and Adrian that people were coming. They tried to act natural, but the people coming were more coldtists, and they were suspicious of where the homeless guy was, and Adrian killed one of the guys and intimidated the other into bringing them inside. There, they found Boris, along with the leader of the Coldtists, Thingo. They managed to convince him that they had NOT killed one of his guys (whose name was Log) and wanted to negotiate for Boris’s release. Apparently, Boris had cost the Coldtists a shipment of flamerails, so Adrian offered him ten bags of 21 gold pieces each, giving him one of the bags as proof. Thingo accepted, and the party grabbed Boris (whose ropes came off real easy) and hustled out, just as Thingo shouted that they’d been swindled (the other nine bags were empty!). The party was chased by the Coldtists, but Gal used magic to break up the terrain behind them, and they got away.
They introduced themselves to Boris, and he told them that he had a key that would unlock an unexplored portion of a ruin. He left it with a friend, Lef (Lev? Lif? Left?), and they went to his place. But he wasn’t there, and he didn’t answer Boris’s watch call. The party went to a nearby pawn shop to see if Lef(?) had sold it, and, through Troost’s truth magic and intimidation, the pawn shop owner revealed that Lef had sold it to him a couple hours ago, then someone had bought it half an hour later. That person had also bought an “I love beer” pin, so the party went in search of a bar…
